title: Truncation of an integer multiplicity current to a ball whose slice has finite boundary mass
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, S, A ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n) and R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity representation in U (contract IMRep U n) of S (R.Represents S), with weight μ := R.measure = θHⁿ⌞M (Hⁿ = μHE[n]). Let ρ, s ∈ ℝ with 0 < ρ < s and B_s := ball(0, s) ⊆ U, and assume: (i) ∂S(β) = 0 for every β ∈ 𝒟^m(U) with tsupport β ⊆ B_s; (ii) A(ω) = ∫_{ball(0,ρ)} ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) (Bochner integral) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U); (iii) M_{B_s}(∂A) < ∞ (SimonGMT massOn, Euclidean coefficient norm). Then there are Ŝ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) and an IMRep R′ in ℝ^P such that R′ represents Ŝ (so Ŝ is integer multiplicity), R′.measure = μ⌞ball(0, ρ), Ŝ(ω) = currentEval(S, ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) with tsupport ω ⊆ ball(0, ρ), ∂Ŝ(β) = 0 for every β ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) with tsupport β ⊆ ball(0, ρ), and M_{ℝ^P}(∂Ŝ) ≤ M_{B_s}(∂A).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S A : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (R : IMRep U (m + 1)) (ρ s : ℝ), IsOpen U → R.Represents S → (∀ β : TestFormOn U m, tsupport (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ ball 0 s → S.boundary β = 0) → 0 < ρ → ρ < s → ball (0 : Euclid P) s ⊆ U → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), A ω = ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid P) ρ, R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂R.measure) → A.boundary.massOn (ball 0 s) ≠ ∞ → ∃ (Ŝ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (R' : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), R'.Represents Ŝ ∧ R'.measure = R.measure.restrict (ball 0 ρ) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) ⊆ ball 0 ρ → Ŝ ω = currentEval S (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) ∧ (∀ β : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, tsupport (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ ball 0 ρ → Ŝ.boundary β = 0) ∧ Ŝ.boundary.massOn univ ≤ A.boundary.massOn (ball 0 s)
